Total disappointment
Mar 2024 • Couples
We went there based on positive reviews found on the internet (tripadvisor AND Google) and we were more than disappointed.
This does not reflect Vietnamese cuisine at all.
On their menu, they mention that the seafood is fresh. These are far from fresh… quite the contrary.
For the second course, honey sesame chicken, the chicken arrived in a chick-yellow pineapple sauce, very artificial. And the meat came from the co gelator (turkey cutlet).
I do not recommend this restaurant at all. Go on your way.
